_comment: Curated core soundscape for the zen photography game, generated via ElevenLabs sound-generation. Each entry's `out` is relative to assets/audio/ and matches the path a .bank.json already references, so generated files wire up automatically. Run tools/audio/generate_sfx.ps1 with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set. mp3 from the API is converted to the target extension (ogg/wav) via ffmpeg.
